texts: mixed: the peer role and the link to Coraline Ash are on record, but "senior" survives only as an absolute property of the fused role word — nothing says Pell is senior *to Coraline Ash*, so the ranking between the two cannot be recovered or asked about. Split the two claims and state the ordering with a plain comparative: "Pell and Coraline Ash are peers, and Pell is more senior than Coraline Ash."
good. the tending event, its agent and object, both named premodifiers with their own head nouns, and "near the Hollows junction" attached to the station all land as stated.
good. a plain property of a named individual, with nothing invented beyond what the sentence says.
